question: Should the repository accept `defineKeyMoveMigration` as an additive Plugin SDK contract after confirming the five migrated doctor contracts retain their prior compatibility behavior?
rationale: The change consolidates migrations that rewrite persisted user configuration and adds an SDK-level callable surface; repository policy treats both compatibility migrations and Plugin SDK API changes as maintainer-visible decisions.

options.title: Accept the shared SDK helper
options.body: Merge after confirming focused equivalence coverage for all five migrated contracts, including canonical-key precedence and operator-visible doctor output.

options.title: Keep the helper internal for now
options.body: Move or narrow the abstraction so it does not create a supported Plugin SDK contract until an external plugin use case is established.
